purpose: Durable cross-chat handoff state for ChatGPT-assisted OVMS Agent development. Read this file first in a new chat, then verify live GitHub branch/issue state before acting.

user_rules.agent_prompt_prefix: When giving lines to paste into OVMS Agent, omit the OVMS-AGENT> prompt prefix.
user_rules.vax_external_identifier_limit: Treat DEC C/VAX 31-character external identifier limit as hard. Audit every newly introduced externally visible function/global/linker-visible symbol before packaging every milestone/fix.
user_rules.vax_c_compatibility: Avoid implicit function declarations and non-C89 constructs in VAX-facing C.
user_rules.github_source_of_truth: Use connected GitHub as source of truth for committed repository files, searches, branches, diffs, issues, PRs, comments, and history. Use OpenVMS for DEC C/VAX, RMS, DCL, runtime, and live acceptance evidence.
user_rules.project_isolation: Do not mix OVMS Agent build architecture with VMSBBS or other projects.
